rows.note: Genotypes given as mm/mM/MM (m = minor allele); the paper does not name the minor nucleotide, so A is assumed from the G>A notation. Minor allele frequency is 0.40 in cases and 0.48 in controls. Chi-square = 1.44. Recipient genotype results were not shown.

rows.comparison_as_reported: presence (homozygous or heterozygous) vs absence (homozygous wild type) of SNP in donor DNA
rows.subgroup: Donor genotype (donors of allogeneic SCT recipients)
rows.verbatim_source: The donor DNA contained the TLR4 1063A>G SNP in 9 of the 43 case patients (21%) and in 4 (7%) of the 61 control patients successfully genotyped for this polymorphism (OR 3.77 95%CI 1.08–13.2, p = 0.03).
rows.note: The text gives carriers as 9/43 cases and 4/61 controls. The separate genotype counts are taken from Table 3; they match the text (2+7=9, 0+4=4).

rows.verbatim_source: Following multivariate correction for GVHD, CMV serostatus and duration of neutropenia the adjusted OR was 3.76 (95% CI 0.90–15.8, p = 0.07).
rows.note: Adjusted for GVHD, CMV serostatus and duration of neutropenia. Genotype counts are from Table 3.

paper_note: In this Leiden T-cell-depleted alloSCT cohort (44 IA cases, 64 controls), only donor-genotype results are reported (Table 3: allelic ORs with mm/mM/MM counts; Table 4: SNP-pair combinations), while recipient genotype comparisons were 'data not shown' with no significant differences.
